title: Optimization & Evaluation
summary: This module provides comprehensive tools for optimizing and evaluating DSPy programs. It includes various teleprompters for automated prompt engineering and program refinement, alongside a suite of metrics for rigorous performance assessment.

nodes.label: Orchestrate Program Optimization
nodes.title: DSPy Teleprompters
nodes.description: A collection of advanced optimizers (teleprompters) that automate prompt engineering, few-shot example selection, and program refinement using techniques like evolutionary search, RL, and Bayesian optimization.

nodes.label: Assess Program Performance
nodes.title: DSPy Evaluation Metrics
nodes.description: Provides a suite of metrics for rigorously evaluating DSPy programs, including LLM-based semantic evaluations (recall, precision, completeness, groundedness) and traditional exact match/F1-score metrics.

nodes.label: Generate Program Insights & Instructions
nodes.title: DSPy Program Proposers
nodes.description: Tools for generating descriptions of datasets, programs, and individual modules, as well as proposing optimized instructions for Language Models to enhance program understanding and refinement.

nodes.label: DSPy Program to Optimize
nodes.title: DSPy Program
nodes.description: The core DSPy program (a Module instance) that is being optimized and evaluated by the teleprompters and metrics.

nodes.label: Training/Evaluation Data
nodes.title: DSPy Examples Dataset
nodes.description: A collection of input-output examples used by teleprompters for optimization and by evaluation metrics for performance assessment.

nodes.label: Language Models (LLMs)
nodes.title: Integrated Language Models
nodes.description: The underlying Language Models that execute DSPy program steps, generate proposals, and perform LLM-based evaluations.

groups.label: Optimization Core
groups.title: Core Optimization Algorithms & Proposers
groups.description: Components responsible for driving the automated improvement of DSPy programs, including various teleprompters and instruction generation tools.

groups.label: Evaluation Framework
groups.title: Program Performance Assessment
groups.description: The system for measuring and reporting the quality and effectiveness of DSPy programs using a diverse set of metrics.

groups.label: Program Context
groups.title: Target Program and Data
groups.description: The DSPy program under optimization/evaluation and the dataset used to train and test its performance.

groups.label: Underlying Infrastructure
groups.title: Language Model Integration
groups.description: The large language models that power the execution, generation, and evaluation capabilities within the module.
